86.originalBody:
当前 main 的行业路由仍用两参数 fenceRuleRowId 和固定 v-next，底层已有版本身份契约，导致服务端类型检查失败；修复同时消除旧固定版本提案流程的重复身份风险。本次复用基座已有版本递增、当前基线校验、同事务 dry-run 确认、事件及审批写入；保留本仓原有权限中间件，并对同一 pending dry-run 加行锁。连续提案分别落 v2/v3，失败不会消耗 pending 或留下半条事件/审批。

验证：本仓 server 与 web 两项类型检查通过；16 项新增/更新回归通过。围栏测试使用真实隔离 PostgreSQL、RLS 与五元事件，成员身份和写入故障由模拟夹具注入；Tiger 交易执行器仅模拟，未接实盘。覆盖重复/并发提案、跨区/错规则/非 pending 拒绝、基线拒绝后重试、完整回滚及权限。

扩展围栏检查仍有既有失败：共享 SDK 测试保留旧两参数调用及无版本事件断言；Eagle、Hyper 的遗留 AI-PM 围栏资产还缺少当前 DSL 要求的 version/default_level 字段。相关 SDK 生产代码、测试和夹具未被本 PR 修改，源文件已与基线比对，失败日志随交付留存。 不能把 allowFailure 流水线成功等同于全部业务测试通过。

风险：review。本 PR 涉及围栏、事件、审批及 Tiger 授权输入，按开发协议保留 risk/review 人审；不移除风险标签，不强制合并。回滚：revert 本 PR，不改数据库 schema 或依赖。

任务卡：https://cnb.cool/workloom-ai/workroom-andromeda/-/issues/85

变更路径：
- `apps/server/src/trpc/router.ts`
- `apps/server/src/trpc/fence-proposal.pg.test.ts`

ciPolicyChanges.rationale: Retain normal source/main alignment with explicit conflicts. Legacy review preparation/publication and NPC repair dispatch fail before IO; repair diagnostics return to the current Codex session.

Repository-local native main scheduling performs deterministic admission/session record/reconcile/release operations only. Legacy base stage names contain syntax checks and no model image or calls; original locks and five-minute recovery remain.
Historical pure receipt readers remain, but CLI and runReview reject before SDK, publisher, subprocess, network or model work. No paid platform approval is created.

Persist append-only events and exact tasks on the protected state branch via normal fast-forward CAS. Recover lost push acknowledgement by transaction ID; do not force or blindly repeat external actions.

Verify schema 2 and the complete exact tracked runtime closure, upstream provenance, regular Git objects, checkout/digest identity and target adapters. Missing, altered, foreign or symlink assets fail.
Run the real retained canonical parsing/decision/negative cases; per-target post-commit regression confirms the installed copy executes with current protocol semantics.

Bind repository, PR, source, main, complete compare files, labels, readiness and original CI in snapshots. Candidate creation/merge uses immutable protected source, unique recovery identity and exact original two-parent verification.
Keep the previously verified parser locked at the exact existing runtime version. No SDK or paid model package is introduced; actual installed parser is tested in each owned target checkout.
Use canonical current repository protocol: ordinary overlap is advisory, permanent open-PR occupation is removed, and exact Git/PR, current main and fenced lease admission remain enforced.

Handoff requires a clean exact checkout and actual session review/test; source and body read back before durable storage. Bootstrap/activation verify complete manifest, prepared source/main and real product CI before changing human approval counters.
Require explicit frozen expected source and native repository identity before packaging/upload; current branch/main/tag alone cannot substitute for exact source proof.
Retain official repository-bound API/Git authentication, read retry and zero write retries. Runtime credentials remain process-only and redacted; no model service is called.

Validate actual Codex exact repo/PR/head/main/policy/files/tests/timestamps/dependencies and CI IDs. Missing, stale, tampered or partial review, live lease, unresolved dependency and unknown write remain blockers for that task.
Parse local CI and append only missing delivery includes. Compare the remaining complete configuration hash to preserve existing target pipelines, selectors and permissions.
Reject immediately before any model, credential, filesystem, network or SDK operation because the owner revoked platform AI.

Actual post-commit tests cover exact review drift/partial receipts, leases/CAS/lost acknowledgements, candidates/permissions/dependencies, red-oldest isolation, frozen releases/private redirects and disabled model/NPC IO. Explicitly retain one non-applicable shared UI lane skip per target.
Keep actual task IDs and scoped task contracts. Existing task card creation/validation and errors remain; ready handoff cannot manufacture a lease or a platform approval.

Use current Codex provider with platformAI=false; preserve existing target product pipelines and business holds. Require implementation-change explanations and invalidate receipts on exact policy/source/main drift.

Keep repository/source/main/path and required task contracts. Installed sensitive changes require accurate source admission and live lease checks; old open-PR order no longer occupies a module forever.
Add deterministic installed queue/protocol regression as an independent required PR pipeline without weakening any original product gate or treating unrelated UI publication as tested.
Use the exact reviewed canonical parser dependency/integrity lock; installation ignores package scripts and does not request a model service.

Append three deterministic repository-local includes while retaining all original product pipeline/stage/check signals. Tiger switches only the four legacy protocol invocations to their exact canonical root equivalents; Python, evidence and industry checks remain.

Select healthy reviewed sources independently of older failures; use immutable candidates, all original CI, real dependencies, fenced sensitive integration lease and exact ordinary merge receipts. No paid review/recovery dispatcher or shared AI capacity remains.

Normalize the bootstrap gate to delivery-bootstrap-checks and run only installation ledger/assets, syntax and existing Codex session verification. Exact onboarding branch selection and independent original product checks remain.

Keep integration and frozen publication independent. Require exact source/build/event/tag/manifest/digests; authenticate only the initial official private download request, bound redirect/stream failures and omit token on later requests.
